☸️ At dusk, the whole of Boudha starts walking — clockwise around the great stupa, prayer wheels turning as they go.

From the golden tower, the eyes of the Buddha look out in all four directions. Prayer flags run down from the spire, and chanting drifts from the monasteries around the square.

Boudhanath is part of the Kathmandu Valley UNESCO World Heritage Site and a living centre of Tibetan Buddhism. Everyone is welcome — just join the flow, clockwise.

🙏 Our 3-day Kathmandu Heritage & Culture tour brings you here, along with Swayambhunath, Pashupatinath and the royal squares of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur — private to your group.

🚁 What if you could stand in front of Everest — without two weeks on the trail?

Our 4-day Everest Helicopter Tour does exactly that:
🏔️ A landing on Kala Patthar (5,545 m), with Everest, Nuptse and Lhotse right in front of you
💎 A sweep over the turquoise Gokyo Lakes
🛕 A guided day among Kathmandu's UNESCO heritage sites
🏨 Stays at Yatri Suites and Spa, with welcome and departure dinners

The helicopter is chartered only for your group — never shared. It flies only in safe weather; if the morning is cloudy, we fly the next clear one.

No fitness needed beyond short walks. The altitude at the landing is real, so the stop is about 15–20 minutes — anyone with a heart or lung condition should check with their doctor first.

Dreaming of Bhutan? Save this before you plan 📌

🛂 Every visitor needs a Bhutan visa — TempleFront arranges it for you before you travel.
🧭 You travel with a licensed Bhutanese guide and a private driver, as national policy requires.
💵 The government's Sustainable Development Fee is USD 100 per person per night for most visitors. Indian nationals have their own, lower rate — ask us for the current figure. The fee helps fund Bhutan's free healthcare, education and conservation.
🍂 October–November brings the clearest mountain views; March–May, rhododendrons in bloom. Avoid June–August, the heavy monsoon.
🏯 The crown of the trip: the hike to Taktsang, the Tiger's Nest, on a cliff some 900 m above the valley floor.

Our 7-day Bhutan journey covers Paro, Thimphu, the Dochula Pass, Punakha and Tiger's Nest — private to your group.
